title: Correct film area
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the film area from the grid, obtaining 31a².

title: Correct molecule diameter formula
description: Essential: The final expression for the molecular diameter must be d = mV / [31a²k(m+n)].

title: Volume of oleic acid in droplet
description: Important: The solution must correctly find the volume of pure oleic acid in one droplet as V_oleic = (m/(m+n)) * (V/k).

title: Model of film as cylinder
description: Important: The reasoning must equate the film volume (area × thickness) to the volume of oleic acid in the droplet.

title: Interpretation of volume ratio
description: Important: The student must correctly interpret 'm:n' as the volume ratio of oleic acid to alcohol in the solution.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The answer includes correct units (a² for area, length units for diameter) or a dimensional analysis.

title: Incorrect area count
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the area is miscounted from the grid (e.g., not 31 squares).

title: Volume fraction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the volume fraction of oleic acid is misapplied (e.g., using n/(m+n) or confusing the ratio).

title: Droplet volume mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if failing to divide the total volume V by the number of droplets k to find the volume per droplet.
